why_one_recoverable_variation_can_be_suf: Exact condition says inject a recoverable frontend failure, not every possible HTTP status, DOM exception, GPU loss, conflict or generation action. It does not require exhaustive fault injection to accept174.

Current action catch/finally retains closure Sets/preferences/draft and rerenders from them. Capabilities error before job creation exercises this shared path without uncertain mutation semantics. Source review corroborates retained state, while actual test must prove observed flow.

A503 is transport/read failure presented/recovered by frontend. Report it as such; never describe it as thrown DOM exception or evidence for every backend/driver/error class. No need inject arbitrary render throw merely because word frontend appears.
source_mechanism: mode/seconds/preferenceDraft and preferences/repair/lock collections live in openIntelligentRota closure; CSS/viewport fit does not reconstruct these variables. render serializes them into actual selected/checked controls.
Mode/lock/repair onchange intentionally rerenders; lock and repair on the same slot are mutually exclusive. Disabled repair controls outside repair mode are an existing policy, not lost repair state.
rememberDraft stores preference controls on input/change. Add appends only explicit committed preference object. Jobs payload includes committed preferences only, not unsent row.

action guards duplicate busy actions, catches nonconflict error, reports notice, optionally refreshes known job, then reenables/renders without clearing planning choices. Capabilities error with no job skips extra jobGET.
No numeric CSS/style change to174 state logic; currentCSS source differs from olderauditacc46 because item31 applied2e4f. Newruntime test must hold current2e4f/build, not oldCSS audit attribution.
outside_exact174_not_silently_certified: Server/GPU scheduling correctness, quality/optimization results, backend lock enforcement and permission authorization. Test only frontend preservation and exact payload.

Template allocation/quickAutoassign/reversal/cancelApply/publish and localassistant/teaching/calendar workflows are separate controls/items; no need replay them to prove this three-control planning preservation requirement.

Conflict handoff deliberately reopens another workspace; explicit Close/discard/account change ends current draft lifetime. Do not claim persistence across such transitions from in-place503 evidence. If user requirement later includes those transitions, treat them as distinct required scope instead of asserting this test covers them.

Job create network-unknown outcome and late accepted results are separate recovery semantics. This read-before-write case must not encourage retrying an uncertain create; do not imply it certifies automatic mutation replay.
additional_variations_only_if_evidence_r: If resize causes actual DOM replacement with missing state, or one control group is not exercised, add that precise breakpoint/group case before acceptance.

If eventual payload uses wrong IDs/order/committed preference or aftererrorstate differs from baseline, reproduce/fix actual frontend bug preserving transport contract, then rerun meaningful same cases.
